versions.changelog:
xhs-topic-track 1.0.0

- Initial release: provides keyword search, note details and comments, and creator post monitoring for Xiaohongshu (小红书) public data.
- Enables structured retrieval for analysis, research, and content strategy, supporting up to 10,000 items per query.
- API token (GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN) required; does not support private or login-required data.
- Usage scenarios, routing logic, input rules, and error handling clearly documented in SKILL.md.
